title: 26 U.S.C. 448, Limitation on use of cash method of accounting (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: How is the three-year test run when the partnership may not have existed for three years?
passages.excerpt: If the entity was not in existence for the entire 3-year period referred to in paragraph (1), such paragraph shall be applied on the basis of the period during which such entity (or trade or business) was in existence.
